name: unicode
title: Unicode Characters
description: Arrows, math, currency, punctuation, keyboard symbols, box drawing, Greek and accented letters in a grid to copy or paste. Search by name, alias, HTML entity, LaTeX command or code point.
author: pal

store.tagline: Arrows, math, currency, dashes and keyboard glyphs to paste
features: About 1,800 characters in sections: arrows, math, Greek, currency, quotes and dashes, fractions, Mac keys (⌘ ⌥ ⇧ ⌃), box drawing
Search by name, code point (`2192`), HTML entity (`rarr`), LaTeX (`\alpha`) or a plain word (`cmd`, `tick`, `eur`)
`enter` copies the character, `cmd+enter` pastes it into the app in front
Copy the code point (`U+2192`), the HTML entity (`→`) or the numeric reference instead
A detail pane with the name and the character large, its block, UTF-8 bytes, LaTeX command and aliases
The last twelve copied lead in a Recent section

screenshots.caption: The ones copied lately first, then every character in a grid by block; the full name of the one under the cursor below
Searching arrow: the matches in every block, the recent ones first
Copy or paste the character, or copy its code point, HTML entity or numeric reference
